observations: Photos 0 and 1 show the same scene: an open shipping container on a rusty truck, packed on three wooden shelves with dozens of used car engines.
A man in a red shirt and cap is marking the engines with a pen; handwritten numbers are visible on some engine covers.
Most engines look like V6 units with flywheels or flex plates exposed; several flex plates are rusty.
Some engines carry black plastic timing covers, others are bare; they are not all the same engine.
No single engine is singled out, and no engine code, block stamp or label is readable in either photo.
A watermark reading 'G.O MERCHANTS LTD' crosses both photos, so these look like a dealer's stock photos.
No photo of any engine running, of compression, of the oil or of the inside of any engine.

identity.kind: used car engine (one of a container lot, unit not specified)

claims.claim: Engines for 2008-2015 RX350, ES350, IS250, Toyota Camry and others
claims.evidence: No engine code or block stamp is readable in photo 0 or photo 1, and the list covers engines of different sizes and prices; which engine is offered is not stated.
Photos 0 and 1 show used engines with rusty flex plates stacked in a container, not new units.
Internal history of a used engine cannot be seen from outside photos.
No clip of any engine running or a compression test.
No receipt or warranty document is shown; a container lot of used imported engines is unlikely to carry an original retail receipt.

risks.risk: Which engine is being sold is unknown; a 2.5 litre IS250 engine and a 3.5 litre RX350 engine price very differently.
risks.proof: Close photo of the specific engine offered with its engine code or block stamp readable.
risks.if_unproven: cannot be priced until the engine is named

risks.risk: Engine may have low compression, a knock or internal damage.
risks.proof: Clip of the specific engine test started on a stand or in a car, plus a compression gauge reading per cylinder.

risks.risk: Missing or broken ancillaries such as sensors, coils, injectors, wiring harness or ECU.
risks.proof: Photos of the chosen engine from all four sides showing what is attached.

risks.risk: Rust or water inside from shipping or storage.
risks.proof: Photo of the dipstick and oil cap underside, and of the intake ports with the throttle body removed.

risks.risk: Photos are a dealer's general stock photos, not the unit the buyer would receive.
risks.proof: Photo of the chosen engine with a handwritten note of today's date and the seller's name placed on it.
risks.if_unproven: priced only on the agent's inspection before payment

proof_requests: Name the one engine offered and send a close photo of its engine code or block stamp.
Clip of that engine test started and idling, with sound.
Compression readings for every cylinder on that engine.
Photos of that engine from all sides showing attached parts.
Photo of that engine with a handwritten note of today's date.
Photo of the receipt or warranty document if it exists.
response.reason: The photos show a container lot of many different used engines and the seller lists several engine families, so the engine that sets the price is not identified and no single item can be priced even at its worst case.
